name: Zechariah
lede: The thirty-eighth book of the Bible, in full: the night visions of Zechariah — the horses among the myrtles, the measuring line, Joshua the high priest, the candlestick of gold and the two olive-trees, the flying roll and the four chariots; then thy king cometh unto thee, lowly, and riding upon an ass; the thirty pieces of silver; a fountain opened; and the day of Jehovah, when his feet shall stand upon the mount of Olives — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Night Visions
books.blurb: Return unto me, and I will return unto you; a man riding upon a red horse among the myrtle-trees in the bottom; four horns and four smiths; a man with a measuring line — I will be unto her a wall of fire round about; Joshua the high priest in filthy garments, and a clean mitre upon his head; the stone with seven eyes; a candlestick all of gold and two olive-trees — not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit, saith Jehovah of hosts.

books.name: The Four Chariots
books.blurb: A flying roll, twenty cubits long; the ephah and the woman sitting in it, carried to the land of Shinar; four chariots coming out from between two mountains of brass; crowns for Joshua — behold, the man whose name is the Branch; the men of Bethel asking of the fasts — execute true judgment, and show kindness; I am returned unto Zion: old men and old women in the streets of Jerusalem, and boys and girls playing; ten men shall take hold of the skirt of a Jew.
